Description
Do you have a noticeable passion for results?
You are bold, empathetic, and very resourceful, especially when results are at stake. You have what it takes: a competitive drive coupled with the exceptional ability to communicate the science behind our client’s products and build lasting business relationships. Such talent and passion make you the right fit for this Full Stack Developer with Syneos Health.
Being a data informed company, data, helps Syneos Health create exceptional experiences for our customers and provides insights into the effectiveness of our client’s products. We are looking for Full Stack Developer who will work on both the back-end infrastructure and front-end Web UI’s of various projects to empower users to understand and act on data insights, and to bring automation and visualization to our products at Syneos Health.
In our fast-paced environment you will work closely with data analysts, data engineers and department stakeholders on designing and building useful and enjoyable applications and tools. Our team consists of technologists, analysts and data scientists who are passionate about creating finely polished and intuitive experiences and, at the same time, obsess over performance, reliability, and maintainability of what we build. We challenge the status quo and strive towards finding the best way to solve problems.
Responsibilities:

  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues across the entire technology stack, including both front-end user interfaces and back-end systems.
  • Maintain, improve, and optimize monthly data processing workflows
  • Maintain, support, and continuously enhance client-facing applications, ensuring a seamless user experience and incorporating feedback from our panel.
  • Consume, orchestrate, and integrate various third-party and internal APIs
  • Create and maintain documentation for workflows, processes and applications
Requirements:
Motivated problem solver with required experience in the following technologies:
  • 5+ years of experience as a full-stack developer, building scalable, secure, and user-friendly web applications from inception to deployment.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience working with Angular, developing dynamic, responsive, and visually engaging user interfaces.
  • 3+ years of expertise with relational databases such as Oracle or SQL Server, including schema design, optimization and advanced querying.
  • 3+ years of experience in designing, developing, and consuming .NET Web APIs, enabling seamless integration and data exchange between systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex issues, identify innovative solutions, and implement effective strategies that align with business goals.
  • Committed to staying updated with emerging technologies, frameworks, and best practices to remain ahead in the rapidly evolving tech landscape.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Highly detail-oriented with a proven ability to manage priorities effectively in a fast-paced and constantly changing environment.
  • Demonstrates the ability to foster positive and collaborative relationships across diverse teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Outstanding ability to manage time efficiently, handle multiple concurrent tasks, and deliver high-quality results within tight deadlines.
  • Flexible and resourceful, capable of thriving in dynamic environments while maintaining focus and productivity.
  • High level of competency in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with teams and navigate diverse workplace cultures.
At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.
Syneos Health Communications is powered by Syneos Health, a global professional services organisation designed to help the biopharmaceutical industry shorten the distance from lab to life. We have a proven pedigree in health, with industry titans in every facet of healthcare. This eliminates guesswork and fuels our passion for total, life-changing solutions. At the heart of health, we’re uniquely poised to predict what’s next and respond to the market’s demand for smarter and faster answers. We are able to help our customers make important decisions within their business due to our unique understanding of the complexities that come along with working in the healthcare industry. Syneos Health Communications is able to make the complex, simple.

title: CONSULTOR DE VENDAS - RJ
description:
O consultor de vendas é responsável por oferecer aos nossos clientes um serviço excepcional, compreendendo e atendendo às suas necessidades e expectativas individuas, enquanto também representa os valores e filosofia da marca, atuando como embaixador Sauer.
Responsabilidades:
Vendas:

  • Oferecer uma experiência de atendimento ao cliente excepcional, excedendo as expectativas por meio de um profundo conhecimento dos produtos e da história da marca;
  • Personalizar a experiência do cliente para superar suas expectativas, colaborando com a equipe e assegurando uma execução eficaz da cerimônia de vendas;
  • Alcançar e superar metas de desempenho individual, garantindo um alto padrão de atendimento ao cliente e qualidade de vendas.
Gestão de Relacionamento com o Cliente:
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos sólidos com os clientes existentes e identificar clientes potenciais para o futuro;
  • Apoiar aos clientes após a venda, oferecendo assistência alinhada os valores da marca e fornecendo recomendações para aprimorar sua experiência;
  • Ser um membro proativo da equipe, demostrando respeito pelos colegas de trabalho, seguindo orientações e fornecendo feedback para promover o sucesso da loja e um ambiente de trabalho positivo;
  • Possuir habilidades persuasivas para aconselhar os clientes sobre tendências na alta joalheria e no mercado de luxo, demonstrando paixão pelos produtos Sauer e mantendo-se atualizado sobre as últimas novidades do setor e da concorrência.
Operações Diárias:
  • Compreender e cumprir todas as políticas e procedimentos operacionais e de segurança da marca;
  • Contribuir para manter a exibição visual de todos os produtos de acordo com os padrões visuais da Sauer;
  • Apoiar as operações da loja conforme necessário, incluindo alterações de preços, apoio a responsabilidades administrativas.
Qualificações:
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em áreas relacionadas a vendas e/ou atendimento ao cliente;
  • Histórico comprovado na obtenção de resultados de vendas;
  • Capacidade de se relacionar com uma base diversificada de clientes.
Habilidades técnicas:
  • Utilizar Microsoft Office, CRM ou sistemas de atendimento ao cliente;
  • Conhecimento em informática e internet.
Habilidades comportamentais:
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Habilidade para negociar e gerenciar conflitos;
  • Atenção aos detalhes, com capacidade de realizar múltiplas tarefas com precisão;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, atitude amigável e respeitosa;
  • Autonomia para trabalhar seguindo diretrizes corporativas;
  • Interesse e sensibilidade para o mundo do luxo, moda, arte e design.
Educação:
  • Diploma universitário;
  • Proficiência em idiomas.

title: Analista de Compras
description:
A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.
Nossos Valores:

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga:
Estamos em busca de um Analista de Compras que será responsável pela condução estratégica e tática dos processos de aquisição de serviços e materiais.
Responsabilidades:
  • Desenvolver estratégias alinhadas aos objetivos de negócios.
  • Avaliar o custo-benefício e realizar análises financeiras.
  • Conduzir negociações focadas em preços e condições contratuais favoráveis.
  • Identificar e cultivar parcerias com fornecedores que agreguem valor.
  • Antecipar e mitigar riscos associados à aquisição de serviços e materiais.
  • Buscar oportunidades constantes para inovação e melhoria nos processos de aquisição.
  • Colaborar estreitamente com outras áreas para alinhar aquisições aos objetivos corporativos.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências de mercado e mudanças no setor.
  • Garantir conformidade com regulamentações internas e externas.
  • Comunicar efetivamente estratégias e decisões de aquisição para partes interessadas.
Requisitos:
  • Formação Superior Completa em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência prévia como comprador em processos de aquição de materiais e serviços industriais.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA
Estamos em busca de um(a) CONSULTOR(A) DE VENDAS (HUNTER DE NEGÓCIOS E LEADS) com perfil dinâmico e comunicativo para prospectar e desenvolver uma carteira de empresas parceiras (no varejo e comércio em geral), com foco em captação de leads e vendas de serviços de internet banda larga e serviços agregados para residências. Somos uma empresa inclusiva! PCD’S são muito bem-vindos em nosso time.
#VemSerLiveOne!
O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Experiência comprovada com vendas diretas para empresas ou abertura de parcerias comerciais;
  • Profundo entendimento em técnicas de vendas e negociações (preferencialmente em produtos de Telefonia);

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES
  • Graduação em andamento em Administração, Marketing, ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano com vendas diretas e ou abertura de negócios com parceiros comerciais;
  • Residência próxima ao local de trabalho;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e mídias digitais;
  • Disponibilidade trabalhar em horário comercial;
  • Flexibilidade para realizar ações externas;
  • Carro próprio e CNH ativa (comprovação obrigatória);
  • Notebook próprio;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens interestaduais (quando necessário).
INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS
  • No Grupo Live One você vai encontrar:
  • Cultura de trabalho que respeita e valoriza as pessoas;
  • Desenvolvimento de Carreira;
  • Plano de Cargos e Salários com possibilidades horizontais e verticais, ou seja, você é o protagonista de sua carreira!

NOSSO JEITO DE SER?
Desde 2014, o Grupo Live One se destaca como uma empresa que valoriza o respeito pelas pessoas, parceria, inovação. Fundado em Campinas, interior de São Paulo, como parte de um grupo empresarial consolidado, crescemos rapidamente e contamos hoje com mais de 1000 colaboradores espalhados por mais de 10 estados do Brasil, que transformam desafios em conquistas todos os dias. Com orgulho de nossas realizações, recebemos, nos últimos dois anos, o selo internacional Great Place to Work (GPTW), reconhecendo nosso compromisso com um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e colaborativo. Esse sucesso é reflexo do esforço conjunto de pessoas que escolheram fazer parte do nosso time e da nossa cultura focada em resultados e inovação.
Na Live One, nossos valores são a base de tudo o que fazemos: Parceria que fortalece relações, Inovação que impulsiona o futuro, Respeito por cada indivíduo, Pessoas como o centro de nossas ações, Atitude para enfrentar desafios, Comprometimento com a excelência e Ética em cada decisão.

02 anos de experiência em atividades similares ao escopo dos serviços. Sendo 01 (um) ano de experiência offshore ou pós graduação em área correlata (nutricionista offshore)

  • Executar a fiscalização técnico-operacional Offshore dos contratos de hotelaria marítima e fornecimento de alimentação, visando garantir pleno atendimento dos requisitos previstos no contrato de prestação dos serviços e legislação sanitária vigente.
  • Inspecionar o recebimento e organizar o armazenamento e movimentação de insumos.
  • Verificar conformidade de processos.
  • Liberar produtos e serviços.
  • Trabalhar de acordo com normas e procedimentos técnicos, de qualidade e de segurança e demonstrar domínio de conhecimentos técnicos específicos da área.
  • Residir em RJ ou ES.
RESPONSABILIDADES
  • Atuar como apoio técnico, dentro do limite de sua competência, em auditorias, inspeções sanitárias, investigações relacionadas a acidentes/incidentes envolvendo a prestação dos serviços fiscalizados.
  • Preencher relatório diário de ocorrência e manter os sistemas de gestão contratual indicados.
  • Verificar cumprimento de notificação da fiscalização e monitorar atendimento de prazos concedidos.
  • Atender denúncias e reclamações, tramitando com os devidos encaminhamentos necessários conforme fluxo de comunicação definido.
  • Elaborar guias, procedimentos e padrões para melhorias da rotina operacional.
  • Ministrar treinamentos internos e promover alinhamentos, sempre queidentificada necessidade ou conforme demanda.
  • Coordenar equipes e avaliar desempenho de profissionais.
  • Apreender cautelarmente e/ou solicitar descarte ou devolução de alimentos ou produtos que possam oferecer risco a saúde ou estejam em desconformidade com a especificação contratual.
  • Realizar ações de educação nutricional e vigilância sanitária nas copas e restaurantes, em articulação com outros setores e participar da elaboração do material didático e/ou orientativo.
  • Elaborar relatório das atividades realizadas e reportar aos públicos de interesse.
  • Demais atividades correlatas, necessárias à execução dos serviços técnicos de fiscalização dos contratos de hotelaria marítima.
R EQUISITOS
  • Residir em Vitória.
  • Graduação em Nutrição.
  • Experiência Offshore OU Pós Graduação (Nutrição Offshore).
  • Fortes habilidades em comunicação e apresentação de resultados.

description:
Há uma jornada de sucesso que se desenha ao longo de quase uma década de dedicação no mercado. A MCS Markup completou 11 anos de comprometimento e excelência, com mais de 350 talentosos profissionais espalhados pelo Brasil.
Nosso compromisso é além de oferecer serviços excepcionais nas áreas de auditoria, contabilidade, consultoria tributária, contábil e financeira. Também somos uma Empresa Cidadã, indo muito além das formalidades. Isso significa que acreditamos no equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, refletindo isso em ações concretas, como a extensão da licença maternidade e paternidade.
Na MCS Markup, o trabalho é mais do que cumprir tarefas; é uma jornada de crescimento e aprendizado constante. Se você deseja fazer parte de um time que valoriza seu desenvolvimento, que enxerga além dos números e busca impactar positivamente a vida das pessoas, então seu lugar é aqui.
Junte-se a nós e faça parte do time MCS Markup, onde as oportunidades se entrelaçam com a paixão por um trabalho bem-feito. Sua carreira está esperando por você - venha fazer história conosco!
Na MCS Markup todas as oportunidades são aderentes à diversidade e abertas a pessoas com deficiência! Valorizamos a singularidade de cada indivíduo e acreditamos que a inclusão enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho.
Se você busca um espaço onde suas habilidades e potencial sejam reconhecidos, esta é a sua chance! Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que preza pela diversidade e pela igualdade.
Sobre o Programa de Estágio MCS MARKUP
O Programa de Estágio MCS identifica, integra e desenvolve estagiários dispostos a construir um futuro profissional e uma carreira de sucesso.
Temos, no mínimo, 25 oportunidades disponíveis pelo Brasil , distribuídas entre diferentes áreas e localidades.
Em que áreas posso atuar?

  • Auditoria Externa - somente candidatos RJ e SP
  • Contábil - somente candidatos RJ, SP e ES
  • Departamento Pessoal – candidatos de todo Brasil
  • Financial Services - somente candidatos SP
  • Fiscal - somente candidatos RJ e SP
  • Direito Empresarial - somente candidatos RJ
  • Previdenciário - somente candidatos de RJ e SP
  • Transaction Services - somente candidatos de SP
O que eu preciso para participar?
  • Matrícula ativa a partir do 3º período de um curso superior de Ciências Contábeis, Direito, Administração, Sistemas de Informação ou a partir do 2º período em Tecnologia da Informação ou Tecnólogo em Recursos Humanos.
  • Ter disponibilidade para iniciar no dia 06/10/2025.
Quais são os benefícios do Programa de Estágio da MCS?
Bolsa auxílio;
Seguro de vida;
Vale refeição ou alimentação;
Vale transporte;
Wellhub (Gympass) e TotalPass;
Parcerias em Instituições de Ensino e Idiomas;
Plataforma de Gestão de Saúde Emocional;
Day off no seu aniversário;
Desenvolvimento e monitoramento profissional com trilha de carreira;
Universidade Corporativa.
Etapas do processo:
Inscrição: Inicie sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro. Fique tranquilo(a), nossa equipe irá analisar as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve.
Dinâmica em grupo: A etapa de dinâmica em grupo é uma fase importante do processo seletivo pois nos permite avaliar suas habilidades interpessoais, trabalho em equipe e resolução de problemas em um ambiente interativo. Durante essa atividade, os candidatos são divididos em grupos e enfrentam desafios ou situações simuladas que exigem colaboração e comunicação.
Entrevista com Recursos Humanos: Você terá a oportunidade de dialogar com nosso time de Atração de Talentos; Seleção. O objetivo é nos conhecermos melhor e garantir que nossos valores e abordagens estejam alinhados com suas crenças e expectativas.
Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta fase, mergulharemos no seu conhecimento técnico para avaliar as habilidades e competências essenciais para a posição.
Retorno do processo: Independentemente do resultado, iremos comunicá-lo a você e discutir os próximos passos.

title: Community Associate
description:
Community Associate

RIO DE JANEIRO, Americas

The world of work is changing…short commutes, flexibility, and convenience are the minimum standards employees want when it comes to how they want to work!

At IWG, we are leading the way. We’ve built the world’s largest workspace network so that our customers can work from wherever, and however they want…in over 120 countries across the globe!

Join us and help us bring more freedom to people and businesses, while expanding our network. You’ll be able to enjoy a great work life balance and competitive benefits, while growing your career path along the way.

The opportunity

As a Community Associate, you’ll work closely with new and existing customers across a myriad of industries, working to create and maintain your own community within your center, where you will help take care of all the administrative and support needs for your customers…so that your customers can focus on running their business.

A typical day at IWG

You arrive a few minutes before your center opens to make sure everything is ready and check there’s nothing the cleaners have missed.

Customers arrive all throughout the morning. One asks you for a changed WiFi code. Another wants to know if his important package has arrived. A woman needs directions to her meeting room… and can you help her set up the projector and show her where to find a great cup of coffee. You’re off to help her get set-up, as soon as you connect the incoming call to another customer. You may sure that all of the services are properly charged, so that invoices are accurate.

It’s time for a quick coffee break, relax and enjoy a few minutes to yourself.

The mail arrives. You sort through it while dealing with a whole host of other customer requests, remembering to email the customer from earlier to let him know his package is waiting for him in his mailbox. And that’s lunch.

A new wave of customers arrive throughout the afternoon. You help a customer with printing and another with their invoice. A customer in a team room say it’s too hot in their office, no problem you are on it and open a ticket in our service portal.

You’ve earned yourself another quick coffee break, relax and enjoy a few minutes to yourself.

Early afternoon, you sit down with the Community Manager to discuss the organization of next week’s networking event in your center. You plan and write the e-invites to customers, then create, print and put-up posters on the noticeboards around the center. To your excitement, the Community Manager is coming around the corner with a prospect (someone interested in joining the IWG community), you share a few details about what makes this space so amazing for your customers and encourage them to join the network soon so they can participate in next week’s networking event – then you head back to finish putting up your posters.

The day is coming to a close. Time to gently ask the large group in meeting room 3 to start wrapping up. You direct them to the nice restaurant you know around the corner, so they can grab a bite and continue their discussion. You ensure everything’s nice and tidy, it’s time to head home.

About you

We’re looking for someone who knows how to manage multiple tasks while providing customers with the best possible service. You also need to be:

  • A good communicator, with the ability to build strong professional relationships and empathize with people’s needs (Ideally 1+ years of customer service experience)
  • Happy taking ownership of problems and finding ways to solve them
  • Positive, enthusiastic, and able to adapt to fast-changing situations
  • Experience and confidence using MS Office and other basic IT equipment
  • Legally eligible to work in the Country you are applying within and at least 18 years old
  • B1 or higher level of English communication skills

What we offer

On top of a competitive total compensation package, you’ll enjoy:

  • Work life balance(no standard nights/weekends)
  • Generous paid time off plans (sick and vacation)
  • Paid Company Holidays per calendar year (in addition to your PTO accrual)
  • A quarterly bonus plan program, with a competitive salary rate
  • A bright and inspiring work environment
  • Training and development opportunities aligned with great career path opportunities
  • A professional workplace community (business casual attire required)

description:
Join to apply for the MÉDICO OFTALMOLOGISTA (RETINA) - CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO - RJ role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Join to apply for the MÉDICO OFTALMOLOGISTA (RETINA) - CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO - RJ role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.
A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

  • diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;
  • realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;
  • avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;
  • programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;
  • ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.
  • realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina. Residência Médica, Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia, Registro de Qualificação de Especialidade (RQE);
Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista;
Especialista em Segmento Posterior com comprovante de Estagio (Fellowship) em Retina.
Informações adicionais
  • Local de Trabalho: Benfica - RJ
  • Carga Horária: 12h semanais
  • Regime de contratação CLT
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

description:

Join to apply for the Associate Sales Operations Analyst role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring Associate Sales Operations Analysts to support a team of experts who help Canonical sales teams achieve their business goals. The Sales Operations team drives continuous process and data quality improvement to ensure orders are processed correctly. The successful candidate will be collaborative and demonstrate initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.
The success of the role is measured against increasing the velocity of deals and the quality of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data used to drive key business decisions. The ideal candidate will be detail oriented problem solver and team player who is passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales teams, is also passionate about our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and will support the delivery of programs to enable Canonical's continued success.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.
The role entails:

  • Support all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales function globally
  • Check opportunities for accuracy and provision orders on successful closure of a deal
  • Support the Sales Operations Analysts and Manager to report on and improve sales data quality and processes
  • Support the sales team globally on CRM and other sales operations systems
  • Deliver sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks
  • Assist the team with automation and streamlining of the Lead to Order process
What we are looking for in you:
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Experience working in an entry-level role in sales operations or related (e.g. financial analysis, sales analysis or sales order processing), preferably in the technology industry
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work productively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization on a global scale
  • Ability to work across team boundaries and communicate effectively
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
What Canonical offers
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Página da Vaga | ANALISTA DE CUSTO PLENO
description:
Job description

Somos um time que cuida da limpeza do seu lar gerando bem-estar, no qual combinamos determinação e comprometimento para entregarmos produtos de qualidade.

Entendemos que para obter os melhores resultados, precisamos dos melhores profissionais.

Estamos à procura de talentos que sejam criativos, inovadores e ousados na busca por conhecimento, que tragam resultados sustentáveis ao Grupo Limppano.

Se você tem prazer em contribuir, gosta do que faz, e é focado em resultados essa VAGA é para VOCÊ!


Main responsibilities

Diariamente você vai:

  • Elaboração e acompanhamento de orçamentos: Analisar e controlar os custos, elaborar projeções e acompanhar o realizado em relação ao orçado;
  • Análise e controle de custos: Monitorar os custos diretos e indiretos, identificar variações e propor ações para redução de gastos;
  • Cálculo e análise de custos de produtos e serviços: Determinar o custo de produção, avaliar a rentabilidade de produtos e serviços, e identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Gestão de estoque: Analisar e controlar os estoques, visando otimizar os níveis de estoque e reduzir custos de armazenagem;
  • Cálculo de custos padrão e análise de desvios: Determinar os custos padrão para cada produto ou serviço e analisar os desvios em relação aos custos reais, identificando as causas e propondo ações corretivas.
  • Elaboração de relatórios e indicadores de custos: Gerar relatórios e indicadores de desempenho para acompanhamento e tomada de decisões;
  • Participação em projetos de redução de custos: Contribuir para projetos que visam a redução de custos e otimização de processos;
  • Suporte à área financeira e contábil: Fornecer informações sobre custos para a área financeira e contábil, auxiliando na elaboração de demonstrações contábeis e fiscais;
  • Análise de preços de venda: Avaliar a formação de preços, considerando os custos e a margem de lucro desejada.

Requirements and skills

Para você fazer parte do nosso Grupo de talentos, você precisa ter:

  • Formação: Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Finanças, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência de custos, formação de preços, análise de custos, orçamentos, estoques;
  • Experiência com planejamento financeiro, controle orçamentário, CAPEX/OPEX;
  • Experiência em modelagem financeira, análise de sensibilidade;
  • Desejável CRC ativo;
  • Experiência e conhecimento das melhores práticas de contabilidade (CPCs).

Sistemas e Ferramentas

  • ERP (ex: SAP, Protheus, Oracle, Sankhya entre outros);
  • Excel avançado (com VBA);
  • Power BI (como diferencial).

Additional information

Além de um ambiente desenvolvedor, oferecemos ao nosso time:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Day Off;
  • Refeição no local;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com faculdades;
  • Convênio com farmácias;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Descontos nos nossos produtos em nossa loja online.

The WHS Coordinator will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risks in our processes, ensuring a safe and healthful working environment for associates inside operations.

  • Perform site safety audits to identify non-compliance issues and implement solutions to eliminate risks and prevent injuries.
  • Audit record-keeping practices and safety database entries to ensure alignment with global standards and local regulations.
  • Audit workplace organization and associate behaviors to ensure training, auditing, and scoring are accurate and consistent.
  • Perform and report incident investigations.

  • Experience with Microsoft Office products.
  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules, including weekends, nights, and holidays.
  • Technical course in Occupational Safety with registration at the Ministry of Labor and Employment (MTE).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, working alongside FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

The Position

The overall purpose of the Insurance Manager is to ensure the efficient implementation and supervision of insurance coverage according to FIFA requirements. The Insurance Manager will also serve as the local contact for Insurance Brokers.

All tasks should be conducted in close collaboration with the FIFA Insurance Lead, and where needed, with the FIFA Audit, Risk & Advisory subdivision.

  • Manage claims (Personal, Property, Liability), recording, administering, and reporting them, and coordinating with the FIFA Lead Insurance, brokers, and insurers.
  • Serve as the insurance interface for all internal and external stakeholders of FWWC 2027.
  • Identify and evaluate potential risks, proposing countermeasures.
  • Support the implementation of a local risk management program.
  • Organize regular insurance surveys.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in insurance and risk management.
  • Solid experience with the Brazilian insurance market and risk management, including contract drafting.
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian insurance laws and standard practices.
  • Familiarity with local market players and negotiation experience.
  • Proven track record in risk management and insurance issue resolution, including understanding of deductible settings.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Spanish and/or German skills are a plus.

Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin

The Company You’ll Join
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.
Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.
Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.
For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

  • Please submit resume in English**
The Company You’ll Join
At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.
We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.
At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.
To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.
The Problems You’ll Solve
As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on-boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.
  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on-boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on-boarding process
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post-sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on-boarding experience for customers
The Impact You’ll Have
You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.
About You
From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem-solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world-class on-boarding experience.
  • Proven success in a project management capacity
  • Ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Experience working with financial data and information
  • Great people skills – high degree of empathy and great communication skills
  • Experience working with clients
  • Experience in implementing and successfully managing small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements
  • Interested in working with enterprise software
Salary
Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. If you are located in New York, New York, our minimum cash compensation salary range for this role is $81,000 - $85,000 (if applicable, + commission). Descrição da vaga
A Origem Energia
Nosso propósito é contribuir para o desenvolvimento do Brasil por meio da integração energética de maneira segura, inovadora e eficiente.
Aqui, energia não nos falta para buscar os melhores resultados, sempre com a segurança em primeiro lugar. Na Origem não existem problemas “dos outros”, trabalhamos unidos como um só time e somos eficientes em tudo que fazemos, evitando desperdícios. Entendemos que só assim continuaremos crescendo, gerando oportunidades para todos e contribuindo para uma transição segura da matriz energética brasileira rumo a uma economia de baixo carbono.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver, conduzir e acompanhar programas de capacitação e trilhas de aprendizagem desde a fase de diagnóstico, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia e cultura organizacional da Cia, de modo a gerar impacto real nos resultados do negócio.
  • Participar ativamente do ciclo de avaliação de desempenho em todas as suas etapas, desde o planejamento até o fechamento, participando de feedbacks e apoiando líderes e colaboradores na construção dos planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDI).
  • Ministrar treinamentos, workshops e apresentações para públicos diversos, transmitindo conteúdos de forma engajadora.
  • Conduzir o programa de onboarding de novos colaboradores a fim de promover engajamento e o desempenho, atuando no mapeamento e produção de conteúdos com áreas parceiras.
  • Atuar no mapeamento e curadoria de conteúdos e fornecedores que contribuirão para a produção de conteúdos e experiências de aprendizagem.
  • Participar da construção de planos de comunicação eficazes para promover as iniciativas da área junto a áreas parceiras de forma engajadora.
  • Participar de iniciativas e projetos de cultura organizacional, pesquisas de engajamento, EVP (proposta de valor ao colaborador) e ações de endomarketing.
  • Atuar na execução e acompanhamento de programas de incentivo, como o programa de bolsas de estudos de pós-graduação e MBA.
  • Realizar análises de indicadores e dados da área, propondo planos de ação e melhorias.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Graduação em Psicologia, Administração, Pedagogia ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência com educação corporativa e avaliação de desempenho;
  • Desejável conhecimento em 6Ds e design instrucional;

Since December 2015, SPDM/PAIS has been responsible, in partnership with the Municipal Health Department of Rio de Janeiro, for managing the Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

The hospital infrastructure includes ten floors with emergency services and adult, pediatric, and neonatal Intensive Care Units (ICU); maternity; medical, general surgery, bucomaxillofacial, neurosurgery, psychiatry, pediatrics, and orthopedics clinics. Imaging exams (X-ray, CT, ultrasound, ECG, echocardiography) and laboratory tests are also performed.

Due to the large elderly population in the West Zone served by the hospital, there are two wards dedicated to this demographic.

The Burn Treatment Center is another feature, offering an exclusive ICU to prevent infections that can be severe for burn patients.

The unit also includes the Regional Emergency Coordination (CER) Santa Cruz, with 39 beds, aimed at handling less complex cases, freeing the HMPII for urgent surgery, high-risk cases, and hospitalization. A notable feature of this CER is the specialized care in Psychiatry and Obstetrics.

Responsibilities and duties

Promote, together with the immediate supervisor, a work environment that fosters continuous improvements in the care process, coordinating with other areas to ensure the institution's objectives are met and users receive quality care.

Requirements and qualifications

  • Complete higher education in Nursing
  • Full specialization in Urgency/Emergency (Emergency Room), Public Health, Health Management, or Multiprofessional Health Residency

description:

Join to apply for the South Region QEHS Manager role at Wärtsilä

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Wärtsiläis a global leaderininnovativetechnologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. We emphasize innovation in sustainable technology and services to help our customers continuously improve their environmental and economic performance. Energy leads the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future. We help our partners to accelerate their decarbonization journeys through our market-leading technologies and power system modelling expertise. These cover decarbonization services, future-fuel enabled balancing power plants, hybrid solutions, energy storage and optimization technology, including the GEMS Digital Energy Platform.
Did you know Wärtsilä has delivered 79 GW of power plant capacity and more than 130 energy storage installations in 180 countries around the world?
In this fast-changing world of energy, we are constantly on the lookout for future-oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services - together. Want to join the ride?
We are looking for a QEHS Manager for our Region South which includes the following countries: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Bolivia, Paraguay and Uruguay . This role leads the development and execution of health, safety, and environmental strategies to ensure compliance with regulations and promote a culture of safety and sustainability across the organization.
The role is responsible for implementing the Wärtsilä QEHS strategies, policies and programs and ensuring organizational excellence in HSEQ compliance and performance. You will be entrusted with the development of Regional Action plans and the advancement of strategic endeavors that contribute to a culture of safety, the reduction of work-related risks, and the maintenance of compliance with established safety, health, and environmental standards at every Wärtsilä site and operational sphere.
The role has 2 direct reports across multiple countries. The position will be located in one of the main locations of the Region (with a preference for location in Brazil) and report to the Americas QEHSS Director.
Key Accountabilities

  • Provides HSE oversight and support across diverse activities, including, not limited to workshops, power plants, service projects, construction sites, and office environments.
  • Leads Health, Safety & Environment activities, ensuring compliance with all local, regional, and international QEHS regulations, as well as company HSE standards
  • Strengthen safety culture by establishing, executing and reinforcing policies, procedures, behaviors, and initiatives.
  • Utilizing strong networking and influencing skills, build clear communication channels representing QEHS across all South Regional sites to a complex set of stakeholders, including the Regional Management, local and global QEHS teams.
  • Support global initiatives with local priorities and applicability, translating and implementing global HSE strategies into relevant and actionable regional plans
  • Monitors Health, Safety, Environment & Quality Performance Metrics, reporting on trends and developing action plans for performance improvement. Drives continuous improvement in Health, Safety, Environment & Quality management.
  • Collaborates with leadership and cross-functional teams to integrate Health, Safety & Environment considerations into business operations and project planning. Engages with external stakeholders, including regulatory bodies, to represent the company's Health, Safety & Environment interests and maintain positive relationships
  • Manages Health, Safety, Environment & Quality compliance, mitigating risks and overseeing adherence to all regulations and standards. Proactively updates practices based on changing regulations and ensures all products and services conform to technical specifications and standards.
  • Lead safety walkthroughs, audits, and site inspections in collaboration with operational teams
  • Spearhead regional risk assessment activities for the South Region, incorporating the identification of hazards, monitoring safety practices, and conducting job safety evaluations.
  • Leads incident investigations, ensuring thorough root cause analysis and ensures appropriate response and reporting procedures are followed.
  • Oversee regular QEHS audits and inspections across regional sites, tracking performance and implementing improvements.
Key Subject Matter Expertise
  • Environmental and Safety Regulations and principles in region
  • Customer Experience Management (CRM) Tools
  • Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001,14001,45001)
  • Quality Development (RCA, Investigation, Inspection, Supplier Development, etc.)
  • Analytical Skills (data analysis, trending, predictive analytics, AI)
  • Security (Physical Security, Travel Security, Crisis Management, Executive Protection)
  • Continuous Improvement (Lean, Six Sigma, TQM, 5S, etc.)
  • Business Acumen. Connecting QEHS Strategy with Business Key Priorities
  • People Leadership and Development
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or related field. Advanced degree or professional certifications (e.g., CSP, NEBOSH, ISO Lead Auditor) are significantly favored.
  • Strong experience in HSE management, preferably in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of local and international HSE regulations and standards.
  • Proven leadership experience with the ability to influence and drive changes.
  • Understanding different management systems and what is needed from a business perspective
  • Excellent communication skills, fluency in written and spoken English. Trilingual (Portuguese and Spanish) preferred.
Last application date: 28/07/2025
At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job-relevant merits and abilities.
Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.
This is Wärtsilä
Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Our team of 18,300 professionals, in more than 230 locations in 77 countries, shape the decarbonisation transformation of our industries across the globe. This model will provide our employees the flexibility of working from home, while also providing the benefits of in-person collaboration. At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data.

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. Today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

About The Job

This role combines hands-on engineering with strategic leadership, focusing on delivering key indicators responsible for user happiness and efficient business operation. You will own a cost-efficient, highly scalable, high-availability system responsible for hosting and running tens of thousands of jobs simultaneously. You are expected to be a product-focused engineer, ready to radically improve the product in an always-changing environment.

We're looking for candidates who can design and build cloud systems, not just operate or maintain them.

About The Team

The Scrapy Cloud team comprises developers, data engineers, and product managers focused on building a high-performance, scalable platform. We prioritize practical engineering and collaboration, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

Requirements

The more items you check from the following list, the better the chance we are looking for each other:

  • Experience in designing and executing experiments, including load testing, performance testing, and evaluating hardware components with basic statistical analysis.

  • Proficiency in Linux internals, including namespaces, containerization, process management, and memory management.
  • Ability to benchmark and integrate commodity server hardware via cloud and bare metal providers.

We are seeking candidates who can design and build cloud systems, rather than just operate or maintain them. The role is suited for those with experience beyond managing Kubernetes/OpenShift, and who have worked with load testing, hardware profiling, or program benchmarking. Candidates should have expertise beyond high-level web frameworks like Spring Boot, Django, Jersey, or Vert.x, and experience developing cloud solutions rather than only working as solution architects.

Benefits

  • Join a self-motivated, progressive, multicultural team.

The role of a Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. Through a clear understanding of their customer's objectives, the CSM can activate a large range of internal and external capabilities to alleviate any pain point, align expectations, as well as help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue offering thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open source infrastructure and applications.
This role is a first step in the CSM organisation. Although you will primarily focus on the Tech segment, including the store customers, you will also have a portfolio assigned. Ubuntu is chosen by thousands of new users every month. Our responsibility is to ensure the best user experience for them through problem-solving, onboarding, enablement and value realisation all the way to success. Collaborating with other teams and participating in campaign efforts, you will connect with a diverse set of users of Canonical products and identify our future champions.
Location: This role will be based remotely worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • A strong focus on supporting customers by finding solutions to ticket requests.
  • Enrich documentation about problem solving, Q&A, onboarding materials.
  • Drive campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
  • Identify high potential as well as high risk customers from newly onboarded users or customers
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Engage with your portfolio of customers to ensure risk identification
  • Collect feedback from customers and format them for review by the product team
What we are looking for in you
  • Customer-facing experience
  • An empathetic individual with a natural drive to help others
  • Passion for technology, infrastructure and Ubuntu in particular is a must
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to structure and constantly update documentation
  • A team player capable of interacting with all departments internally
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Responsabilidades da Posição

  • Definir estratégias de relacionamento com o cliente ao longo da jornada, atraindo novos clientes, promovendo engajamento, retenção e crescimento de receita usando ferramentas de CRM, automações e campanhas segmentadas.
  • Construir jornadas personalizadas e estratégias de fidelização, através da análise de dados de clientes para identificar padrões, tendências e insights relevantes.
  • Gerenciar a base de dados de clientes, garantindo sua qualidade, segmentação e insights acionáveis, planejando e executando campanhas de CRM focadas em aquisição, ativação, retenção e reativação.
  • Criar segmentos de clientes com base em dados demográficos, comportamentais e de compra, para personalizar campanhas e comunicações.
  • Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar fluxos de comunicação e campanhas automatizadas (e-mail, SMS, push, WhatsApp, entre outros), criando conteúdo personalizado e relevante para cada segmento.
  • Realizar testes A/B, análises de performance e gerar relatórios para melhorias contínuas.
  • Administrar ferramentas de CRM e automação, como RD Station, HubSpot, Salesforce, Dynamics, entre outras.
  • Estabelecer KPIs para medir o sucesso das ações de CRM, como taxa de abertura, clique, conversão, retenção e valor vitalício, propondo ações de otimização e apresentando relatórios e insights.
  • Avaliar o ROI das campanhas de CRM, otimizando orçamento e recursos.
  • Colaborar com equipes de Comunicação, Trade, Comercial e Tecnologia para alinhar estratégias e garantir consistência nas ações.
  • Revisar processos e rotinas existentes, garantindo eficiência operacional, minimizando erros, maximizando produtividade e escalabilidade.

Requisitos obrigatórios para a posição

  • Superior completo.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência na área.
  • Domínio de estratégias, execução de CRM, automação de marketing e construção de jornadas de clientes personalizadas.
  • Habilidade com segmentação de base de dados e análise de métricas de campanha.
  • Visão estratégica, perfil analítico, proatividade e orientação a resultados.

Sobre a empresa

Somos a Drogaria Venancio, uma marca carioca com mais de 45 anos, que coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo. title: Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, AI/ML & Analytics
description:
Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, AI/ML & Analytics

4 months ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on an end-to-end data analytics and mlops solution composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on workflow, ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. Your team will own a solution from the analytics and machine learning space, and integrate with the solutions from other teams to build the world's best end-to-end data platform. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hourse! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional Skills That Would Be Nice To Have

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

As a Project Engineer, you’ll oversee all engineering deliverables for your assigned scope, from design validation and approvals to procurement, compliance, and on-site execution. The project delivery function oversees execution, programme coordination, stakeholder engagement, and quality control across all phases of construction. The team works closely with Planning, Commercial, Procurement, QA/QC, HSE, and Site Operations to ensure flawless execution.

  • Familiarity with construction codes, safety regulations, and QA/QC procedures.
  • Proficiency in MS Office, AutoCAD, and project planning tools (Primavera P6 or MS Project).
  • Excellent communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
The Canonical Public Cloud team is looking for enthusiastic engineers to be Ubuntu distribution engineers. Engineers working on the Ubuntu distribution will work closely with the Ubuntu Engineering organization to ensure technologies such as cloud specific agents, webservers, databases, and virtualization and containerization stacks are optimized for public clouds. CPC works closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google, IBM, and Oracle and other world-class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users. Working on the CPC team as a distro engineer means working closely with partners and with Ubuntu to make the best version of Ubuntu for the cloud.
Ubuntu Server is a platform that enables amazing technology the whole world over, and is the #1 operating system in the public clouds. Applicants to this role will have the opportunity to help with everything that goes into evolving Ubuntu. The Public Cloud team builds Ubuntu Server for cloud environments, maintaining extensive continuous deployment operations to deliver images to end users. You will get to work with our experienced team and have the benefits of learning and growing alongside the best engineers in the business.
This role entails

  • Collaborating proactively within a distributed team
  • Fostering a software ecosystem with seamless user experience for all Ubuntu users
  • Evaluating contributions of other engineers to maintain high-quality software standards
  • Collaborating with other teams in the Ubuntu and Debian communities, with upstream projects, and commercially supported customers
  • Debugging issues on open source code and team maintained code
  • Working with the Ubuntu Engineering Server team to maintain and package software such as:
    • Cloud agents (google guest agent, ec2-hibinit-agent, walinuxagent, etc)
    • Traditional server workloads (web servers, databases, network services, etc)
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You value building partnerships with a diverse set of internal and external groups
  • Interest or experience in public cloud operations or architecture
  • Interest or experience in open source maintenance or contribution
  • Understands basic reproducibility and testing steps. Comfortable setting up test systems in containers or virtual machines. Able to describe issues and steps clearly
  • Strong fundamentals in Python
  • Interest in learning Linux distribution packaging
  • Fundamental understanding of package management and dependency resolution
  • Interest in containerization and virtualization such as Docker or OCI service containers, LXD system containers, and local virtualization like Virtualbox or QEMU, or Public Clouds
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. We are hiring a Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management to work on authorization and access management across Canonical's suite of enterprise products and web services, using Go (Golang) and Python.
As a software engineer for Identity Management products of Canonical, you will modernize and expand the capabilities of the identity management solutions we use for authentication and authorization in our products, as well as our canonical.com and ubuntu.com websites. Your work on Identity Management will directly impact the users of all Canonical products.
Technical excellence and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to own the design and delivery of the system, facilitate integrations and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and AMER regions.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Go (Golang) and optionally Python
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints
  • Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation
  • Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies
  • Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You are a software engineer, with specific experience building identity and access management products
  • You are familiar with the open source software, standards, protocols and concepts in the identity space (e.g. OpenID, OAuth, LDAP)
  • You have experience implementing authorization frameworks in distributed systems
  • You value secure coding and standards, and enjoy working on teams that do the same
  • You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform
In addition:
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

description:
